run_remote_spot_master: run the RemoteSpotMaster node to listen for ROS requests to start and control a Spot robot
create_remote_spot_listener: create a RemoteSpotListener instance that subscribes to ROS topics and executes commands on a Spot robot
execute_cmd_method: execute a semicolon-delimited command string on the Spot robot via the execute_cmd callback method
kill_remote_robot_method: power off the Spot robot and shut down the ROS node using the kill_remote_robot callback
init_remote_robot_method: initialize a new Spot robot instance and acquire a lease via the init_remote_robot callback
